- Regions: show several regions at once. The Region row now opens a drawer with every region and an ON / OFF switch each, so you can keep Springlands and Revelwood on and add the next region when you're ready for it. Click the row's name to switch them all on or all off, Ctrl + click a region to show only that one, and + / - folds the drawer away. Pins outside the regions that are on are dimmed or hidden as before, and each one's border is drawn. Your region from 1.3.18 carries over. Requested by FrostyBou.
- Town Portals and the water sources you build now follow the Region filter too.
- Fixed: Ctrl + Shift + F12 could crash the game, rarely, when switching the mod off or on (the map's code was rewritten while the game was running it). Reported by secretroff.
- Fixed: with a controller that isn't an XInput pad (a PlayStation controller, for one), the world map could stop answering the stick after the Map Key was clicked with the mouse, until the mouse moved. Reported by FamanFortune.
